node.statement: Assembly and support bridge: because L_j+U_j=1, sum_{j in G_a} P_ij^+=sum_{j in G_a} P_ij^+ U_j+sum_{j in G_a} P_ij^+ L_j, and by the root definition of M_i^a with U_j=sum_{v:d_v>a*tau} lambda_jv the first sum is exactly M_i^a. Combining validated node 1.4.1 with node 1.4.2.2 yields g_i<=M_i^a+sum_{j in G_a} P_ij^+*(H-d_j)/(H-a*tau). The coefficients P_ij^+ lambda_jv in M_i^a are nonnegative, and validated node 1.1 says every row vertex with d_v>a*tau is hidden with depth in (a*tau,H], so M_i^a is supported entirely on those hidden vertices.
